title: Stop Saying "Very Old"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very old". Use one of these words instead:
• Ancient: an ancient temple
• Elderly: an elderly neighbor
• Antique: an antique clock
• Vintage: a vintage radio
• Age-old: an age-old tradition

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
